cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Pick the Prize
cards.instruction: Make them choose which reward, principle, or relationship matters most when not everything can be kept.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. You can keep the prize money or fund the team trip. Which matters more?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't we do a cheaper trip?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Only if someone adds money. You hold the prize.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm asking you to choose before everyone else quietly pays for it.

mechanism: A corrects the trip budget so B must choose between personal prize retention and paying the team's actual shortfall.
confusable: D197 executes owed cost; D202 asks which value B prioritizes.
comparison: Shared funds and hidden subsidy differ from a relationship calendar.
seedUse: Establish actual shortfall before rejecting a cheaper-trip solution; do not claim all cheaper options cost more.
